content: {"reasoning": "The denial is CO-197 (no prior auth at time of service); silverbridge offers neither a retroactive authorization window nor peer-to-peer, so those routes are foreclosed, and resubmitting as-is or with records would simply re-trigger the same auth denial. A prior correct_and_resubmit touch already failed, so re-fixing data doesn't cure the missing authorization. Under Medicare Advantage rules the member cannot be balance-billed for the provider's authorization failure, so billing the patient or writing off prematurely is wrong; the only legitimate progression with 130 days of filing time and solid documentation (0.85) is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity for the 93229 monitoring.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
